title: Multi-head attention debiasing and contrastive learning for mitigating Dataset Artifacts in Natural Language Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on subsets of validation data where hypothesis length spuriously correlates with specific labels (e.g., short hypotheses biasing toward entailment).
Measuring performance on examples with high lexical overlap between premise and hypothesis (e.g., >80%) where the model incorrectly predicts entailment due to surface similarity.
Assessing model predictions on instances where hypothesis words form a subset of premise words, which typically triggers false entailment predictions.
Analyzing model error rates on examples containing negation words (e.g., 'no', 'not') which models spuriously associate with contradiction labels.
